document.title: Application for Automatic Extension of Time To File U.S. Individual Income Tax Return

boxes.label: For calendar year 2025, or other tax year beginning
Estimate of total tax liability for 2025
Balance due. Subtract line 5 from line 4.
Check here if you're "out of the country" and a U.S. citizen or resident.

document.notes: The amount paid with the extension request routes to Schedule 3 line 10.

extraction.note: Azure ships no prebuilt-tax model for this form, so it reached the generic reader - which emits no field bearing these box names, so every cited route out of this document was dead while looking implemented (spec 075 US1/W42). Read by the declared custom model over every line the 2025 face prints; only line 7 is a payment.

custom.reads: a Form 4868, Application for Automatic Extension of Time To File. Only the amount actually paid with it is a figure on the return.
